messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Scheduling and Participation" as it appears in the following examples.
['WE WILL BE HAPPY IF YOU CAN GET BACK TO US WITH THE FULL DETAILS ABOUT TELECONFERENCE BECAUSE WE ARE INTERESTED IN ATTENDING TELECONFERENCE', 'MovieTickets.com is pleased to offer you and a guest the opportunity to participate in free, pre-release, film screening(s) scheduled to take place in your area in the coming days.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We seek teleconference details to arrange attendance and invite you and a guest to participate in upcoming local film screenings."}
